typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold and larger than body. Column headers are colored (blue for Positive Class, green for Negative Class) and bold. Quoted class descriptions are in red ('Shoot the Enemy') and green ('Safe'). Label values (+1, -1) are bold inside colored strips. Slide number '19' is black inside yellow circle.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Add a white rectangle with blue border at top-left containing bold dark-blue text: 'Training Samples with Labels (Two Classes)'. 3. Add a yellow circle at top-right with black number '19'. 4. Create left column: header 'Positive Class' in blue, below it '"Shoot the Enemy"' in red, below it 'Label' in black. Add a tall red-bordered rectangle containing six enemy airplane line drawings stacked vertically. To its right, add a vertical red/pink strip with six '+1' labels aligned with each plane. 5. Create middle column: header 'Negative Class' in green, below it '"Safe"' in green, below it 'Label' in black. Add a tall green-bordered rectangle containing six safe airplane line drawings stacked vertically. To its right, add a vertical green strip with six '-1' labels aligned with each plane. 6. Top-right panel: white box titled 'Activation Function' with text 'Bi-polar step (-1 , +1)' and 'Threshold at "zero"'; add a purple step-function graph icon on the right side of this box. 7. Middle-right panel: light yellow box titled 'Training' in red. Inside, draw flowchart: 'Input Sample' -> dark red box labeled 'Model' with subtitle '[Any value] -> [-1 , +1]' and purple step icon -> 'Predicted Class' -> orange circle 'LOSS' <- 'Label of Input Sample' with '(+1, -1)' below. 8. Bottom-right panel: light yellow box titled 'Evaluation' in red. Inside, draw flowchart: 'Test Sample' -> dark red box labeled 'Model' with subtitle '[Any value] -> [-1 , +1]' and purple step icon -> 'Predicted Class' -> blue text '(+1, -1)'. 9. Use sans-serif fonts; ensure all quoted text and mathematical brackets are transcribed exactly.
